queries.query: LLM-generated network configuration failures misconfiguration deployment "network configuration" "large language model" error failure
queries.rationale: Discover empirical reports and studies documenting concrete misconfigurations, incorrect device commands, or deployment failures produced by LLMs when authoring network configs (phenomenon identification).
Identify literature framing LLM hallucinations specifically in network/NetOps contexts and characterize examples and definitions used (phenomenon characterization).

queries.query: causes of LLM errors prompt sensitivity context window distribution shift "LLM" "error analysis"
queries.rationale: Locate work analyzing mechanisms that drive LLM mistakes relevant to NetOps: prompt sensitivity, context truncation, distributional mismatch between training data and operational configs.
Find architectures that couple LLM generation with validators, formal checkers, or repair loops (mitigations / architectures for safe NetOps generation).

queries.query: network configuration verification "header space analysis" "NetKAT" SMT-based network verification
queries.rationale: Collect formal verification techniques used to validate network properties and whether they can serve as validators for LLM outputs (mechanisms & mitigations / validator technology).
Survey methods that constrain model output (decoding constraints, program synthesis with specs, constrained language models) applicable to NetOps tasks to reduce unsafe outputs.

queries.query: tool-augmented LLM agents "ReAct" "Toolformer" "tool use" network operations
queries.rationale: Examine agentic frameworks and tool-augmented LLM workflows to see how external tools can assist correctness in network tasks and potential failure modes introduced by orchestration.
Locate existing NetOps/AIOps benchmarks and datasets that could inform evaluation design or expose benchmark validity issues (benchmark inventory and critique).

queries.query: benchmark validity distribution shift adversarial evaluation LLMs "benchmark validity" "robustness"
queries.rationale: Gather literature critiquing benchmarks and proposing validity checks (e.g., distribution shift, adversarial cases, operational realism) relevant to NetOps evaluation.

queries.query: network simulation emulation environments for testing configs "mininet" "ns-3" "GNS3" "emulation" "testbed"
queries.rationale: Identify environments used to execute and validate configurations safely (methodological tools for experimental validation of generated configs).

queries.query: operational correctness metrics NetOps "reachability" "connectivity" "policy compliance" "reachability analysis"
queries.rationale: Compile candidate operational metrics that meaningfully measure correctness, safety, and reliability of generated network actions/configs.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps LLM assistance "operator-in-the-loop" "human-AI collaboration" network operations
queries.rationale: Survey studies on human–AI collaboration for NetOps to understand mitigations based on operator oversight, and human-centric evaluation designs.

queries.query: robustness testing LLMs prompt perturbation input perturbation "sensitivity" "robustness"
queries.rationale: Find methods for robustness evaluation under perturbations (relevant for stress-testing NetOps LLMs against malformed or adversarial intents).

queries.query: taxonomy of agentic failure modes safety of autonomous agents "failure modes" "autonomous agents"
queries.rationale: Obtain broader taxonomies of agentic failure modes that can be specialized to NetOps agent workflows (neighbouring work on agent safety).

queries.query: LLM for network troubleshooting root cause analysis "AIOps" "root cause analysis" "troubleshooting"
queries.rationale: Identify prior work where LLMs assist in troubleshooting, diagnostics, or RCA in networks to compare tasks and failure profiles.

queries.query: public datasets of network configurations "Cisco configs" "router configs dataset" "real-world network configs"
queries.rationale: Find publicly available corpora of device configurations to support realistic evaluation or training-relevant analyses (data sources).

queries.query: ethical legal operational risk autonomous network management "safety critical networks" "legal liability"
queries.rationale: Collect literature on ethical, legal, and risk considerations for deploying autonomous or semi-autonomous NetOps systems (threats to validity / deployment limits).

queries.query: experimental design power analysis paired design model comparison "paired" "power analysis" "statistical test"
queries.rationale: Gather methodological guidance on experiment design and statistical analysis appropriate for comparing model-assisted NetOps interventions and validators.
Broad sweep to identify named systems, tools, and papers that explicitly apply LLMs to network configuration generation or NetOps automation (nearest-neighbour literature).

inclusion_criteria: Scholarly publications (peer-reviewed conference/journal papers) and preprints (arXiv) that directly address LLMs, generative models, or agentic systems applied to network operations, configuration generation, verification, or AIOps.
Work on validators, formal verification, or simulation/emulation methods applicable to validating network configurations.
Benchmarks, datasets, and experimental-methodology papers relevant to NetOps evaluation.
Papers from 2010–2026 with emphasis on 2016–2026 for LLM-specific developments; include older foundational verification or network-theory work where relevant.
Technical reports, tool documentation, or public dataset repositories when they provide unique artifacts or implementations (e.g., Mininet, ns-3, dataset releases).
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical blog posts, opinion pieces, or unverified claims without reproducible artifacts unless they point to primary sources.
Papers unrelated to networks/NetOps (purely NLP/LLM theory with no operational tie) unless they present methods directly translatable to NetOps validators or mitigations.
Commercial marketing materials without reproducible evaluation or primary data.
date_rationale: Focus on literature from ~2016–2026 to capture the emergence and maturation of large pretrained models and recent agentic/tool-augmented methods, while permitting inclusion of older foundational network verification and simulation work (e.g., pre-2016) where it establishes validators, formal methods, or operational metrics applicable to NetOps.
